title: Escalation view information architecture
summary: Decision-ready information architecture for escalated task details. It assigns the actual blocker to the escalation header, removes duplicate escalation outcome surfaces from Pipeline and Result, preserves the failed-step ATTENTION marker, and flattens Goal and Where it stopped into sibling Result rows with a calm red stopped-state tint.
